合适的难度让游戏有趣而不紧张。我们挨个尝试，聊聊每种模式下夜晚的不同感受。
items.prompt: three sliders labeled with stars from one to three on a wooden panel

med: One game rule keeps the rain away forever.
有一条游戏规则能让雨永远停下。
hard: The game rules let the teacher build a quiet class world. No monsters, no hunger, only building and teamwork.
游戏规则让老师搭出一个安静的课堂世界。没有怪物，没有饥饿，只有建造和合作。
items.prompt: an open rulebook with a gavel and a checklist on a small table

med: The recipe book shows how to craft each tool.
配方书展示每种工具的合成方法。
hard: Grandma's real recipe book smells like cinnamon. The game one smells like nothing, but it never gets flour on the pages.
奶奶的配方书有肉桂的香味。游戏里的那本没有味道，但页面上永远不会沾面粉。
items.prompt: an open book with colorful crafting grid diagrams on its pages

med: We learn a crafting recipe for shiny armor.
我们学会了闪亮盔甲的合成配方。
hard: Each crafting recipe needs the right shapes on the grid. We copy the pattern carefully and get a brand-new shield.
每个合成配方都需要在格子上摆对形状。我们仔细照着图案摆放，做出了一面崭新的盾牌。
items.prompt: a three by three crafting grid with iron pieces arranged in a shield pattern

med: Finishing the farm unlocks a new advancement.
建好农场解锁了新进度。
hard: The advancement list is like a treasure map of the whole game. We read it at breakfast and pick our next big goal.
进度列表就像整个游戏的藏宝图。我们边吃早餐边看，挑好下一个大目标。
items.prompt: a golden trophy badge with ribbon and a small checkmark shield

med: The quest sends us to the snowy mountain peak.
任务把我们送到雪山之顶。
hard: The final quest asks us to bring three rare items to the old wizard. We split up, search fast, and meet again at sunset.
最后的任务要我们把三件稀有物品带给老巫师。我们分头行动、快速搜寻，日落时再碰头。
items.prompt: an exclamation-mark quest scroll pinned to a wooden post with a small flag

med: Each heart in the corner means part of our health.
角落里每颗心代表一部分生命值。
hard: When the last heart turns gray, the game is over. We learn to carry cooked food so our hearts stay full and red.
当最后一颗心变灰，游戏就结束了。我们学会随身带熟食，让心一直红红的满满的。
items.prompt: a glossy bright red heart floating with tiny sparkles around it

med: The hunger bar shakes when we are very hungry.
非常饿的时候，饥饿条会抖动。
hard: We watch the hunger bar during the long race across the desert. A quick snack at the halfway point keeps us running strong.
横穿沙漠的长跑中我们盯着饥饿条。半路快点小吃一把，就能继续有力气跑。
items.prompt: a wooden bar showing a row of drumstick icons, mostly full

med: The armor bar fills up when we put on iron armor.
穿上铁甲后护甲条就满了。
hard: The armor bar appears above the hunger bar once we gear up. It slowly breaks during the fight, so we carry spare pieces.
装备好以后，护甲条出现在饥饿条上方。战斗中它会慢慢损坏，所以我们带着备用件。
items.prompt: a row of small silver chestplate icons lined up on a panel

med: The air bubbles shrink while we swim underwater.
在水下游泳时氧气泡会变小。
hard: We dive to the sunken ship and watch the last air bubble pop. Just in time, we swim up and take a huge breath of air.
我们潜到沉船上，看着最后一个氧气泡破掉。我们及时游上水面，深深吸了一大口气。
items.prompt: a line of shiny blue bubbles rising underwater near a small fish

med: The XP orb flies to us when we win a fight.
打赢后经验球朝我们飞来。
hard: The little XP orbs make a bell sound when they reach us. We collect them all and level up twice in one evening.
小经验球到达时会有铃铛声。我们全部收下，一晚上升了两级。
items.prompt: small glowing green orbs floating toward the viewer with sparkle trails

med: The status effect makes him jump extra high.
状态效果让他跳得特别高。
hard: A green icon shows our status effect at the top of the screen. We read what it does before we drink any strange potion.
屏幕上方的绿色图标显示我们的状态效果。喝任何奇怪的药水前，我们先弄清它的作用。
items.prompt: a row of round colorful effect icons with a up-arrow icon glowing green

med: The potion effect lets us see in the dark.
药水效果让我们在黑暗中也能看见。
hard: The night-vision potion effect turns the dark cave bright blue. We follow the map to the treasure room before it wears off.
夜视药水效果让黑暗的洞穴变成亮蓝色。趁效果没消失，我们跟着地图找到了宝藏室。
items.prompt: a glass potion bottle with swirling blue liquid and rising sparkles

med: The enchantment makes the pickaxe dig faster.
附魔让镐子挖得更快。
hard: We put our best enchantment on the fishing rod. Now the fish practically jump into the boat by themselves.
我们给鱼竿附上了最好的附魔。现在鱼儿简直自己往船上跳。
items.prompt: a glowing book with purple magical runes floating around it

med: The bar under the tool shows its durability.
工具下面的小条显示它的耐久度。
hard: The old pickaxe has only one point of durability left. We repair it with spare metal instead of letting it break in the mine.
旧镐子只剩一点耐久度了。我们用备用金属把它修好，不让它在矿井里坏掉。
items.prompt: a pickaxe with a small green durability bar under it, slightly worn

med: Put the apple into the last free slot.
把苹果放进最后一个空栏位。
hard: Every slot in the chest has its own place and job. We label them with signs: food here, tools there, treasure on the top row.
箱子里每个栏位都有自己的位置和任务。我们用牌子做标记：食物这边，工具那边，宝藏放最上面一排。
items.prompt: a single empty square slot panel with one red apple about to be placed

med: One slot can hold an item stack of sixty-four.
一个栏位能装六十四个的物品堆叠。
hard: We sort the item stacks by color and size. A neat chest saves time, especially when the whole team needs arrows fast.
我们按颜色和大小整理物品堆叠。整齐的箱子省时间，特别是全队都急需箭的时候。
items.prompt: a neat stack of sixty-four small wooden blocks with a number badge
